data.case_title: Termination of tenancy by landlord (Kündigung des Mietverhältnisses)
data.title: Landlord's termination of the tenancy (Kündigung des Mietverhältnisses)
data.summary: Landlord Gisela Beispielruhr terminates the tenancy for the apartment at Ruhrallee 77, 2nd floor right, with ordinary notice effective 28 February 2027, citing personal need (Eigenbedarf) because her daughter Lena needs the apartment. The tenant may object under §§574–574b BGB (hardship) in writing, to be received by the landlord by 31 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your landlord has given formal notice to end your tenancy by ordinary termination, stating the move-out date of 28 February 2027 and giving personal need (Eigenbedarf) for her daughter as the reason. German law gives you the right to object (Widerspruch) if ending the tenancy would be an unreasonable hardship for you or your family that outweighs the landlord's interest in getting the apartment back - the app shows until when you can still decide and send such an objection. If you do nothing, the tenancy ends on the stated date and you must hand back the apartment. Given the stakes involved (losing your home), it is worth getting advice from a tenants' association (Mieterverein) or lawyer before the deadline shown.

remedy.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens am 31.12.2026 zugehen.

key_facts.label: Tenancy end date (Kündigung zum)
key_facts.quote: hiermit kündige ich das Mietverhältnis über die Wohnung Ruhrallee 77, 2. Obergeschoss rechts, ordentlich zum 28.02.2027.

key_facts.label: Deadline for hardship objection (Widerspruch spätestens)
key_facts.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens am 31.12.2026 zugehen.

key_facts.label: Reason for termination (Kündigungsgrund)
key_facts.quote: Ich benötige die Wohnung für meine Tochter Lena, die im Frühjahr ihre Stelle am Klinikum in Beispielessen antritt und mit ihrem Partner eine Wohnung in der Nähe sucht.

items.title: Decide whether to object to the termination (hardship objection)
items.action: If moving out would be a hardship for you or your family that outweighs the landlord's interest, send a written objection (Widerspruch) to the landlord asking to continue the tenancy.
items.consequence: If you do not send a written objection by the deadline shown, you may lose the right to object under §§574–574b BGB and the tenancy will end as given notice.
items.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens am 31.12.2026 zugehen.

items.title: Tenancy ends / move out of the apartment
items.action: Move out of the apartment and return it to the landlord by this date; coordinate the handover with the landlord in advance.
items.consequence: If you stay longer without the landlord's agreement, the landlord can demand compensation or take legal steps to enforce the move-out.
items.quote: hiermit kündige ich das Mietverhältnis über die Wohnung Ruhrallee 77, 2. Obergeschoss rechts, ordentlich zum 28.02.2027.
